caveats: Opinion question with no fact core. Readings to avoid: taking Michael's insults of Toby as an objective verdict (they are Michael's bias, which is itself a joke), or Jim's/Pam's self-deprecation about their jobs as calling themselves boring people. Whether Toby counts as a 'main' character is debatable (he is in the main cast from early on). An answer should take a position and give reasons from the show.
reference: Judgment, no single answer. Best-supported: Toby, whom the show itself frames as boring: Michael says everyone will 'vomit due to boredom' at his safety talk (S3E19), 'we're gonna die of boredom' at his radon talk (S6E23), and jokes about 'the boring police' (S7E11). Other defensible picks: Stanley (deliberately disengaged), Pam (calls her own job 'the most boring job in the office', S3E22, and 'I love my boring life', S9E1), Jim as the 'straight man' (but he is the main prankster), Gabe, Oscar, Pete and Clark (S9). Note Toby and Gabe are main-cast-adjacent; if 'main' means original core cast, Stanley or Pam are the usual candidates.

evidence.line: Michael: Ok, you know what? I think that everybody is going to vomit due to boredom. [to warehouse guys] Sorry, he is very lame.
Michael: You know what? We're not gonna die of radon, we're gonna die of boredom.
Michael: Uh, because you've been on the Lam? Because the 'boring police' have been after you, and they finally caught up with you?
Pam: I have the most boring job in the office, so... why wouldn't I have the most boring job on beach day?
Dwight: Come on, this will be the only thrill of your boring life. / Pam: Dwight, you may find this hard to believe, but I love my boring life.
Jim: ... And... I'm boring myself just talking about this. (about his job)

question: Who is the most boring main character in The Office?
owner_note: Owner confirmed (2026-10-06): reference is correct; Toby is the universally accepted boring character.
